text:
maya: flag from kite-v2 int6 onboarding — elevated token split rate in zh and ja under nucleus sampling; greedy looks fine. anyone seen this pattern? :confused:
jorge: can you paste the quick numbers and a tiny repro?
maya: short stats (n=80 per locale):
```
locale mean_entropy token_split_rate
en 3.2 0.01
zh 5.1 0.09
ja 4.9 0.085
```
maya: example src zh: "请填写您的姓名。"
sample: "请 填 写 您 的 姓 名 。"
claire: that gap is large. argmax stable or does greedy also split?
maya: greedy/top-1 is stable, BLEU close to baseline. stochastic sampling (top-p 0.92, temp 0.8) shows splits and BLEU drop ~1.2 pts for zh->en. I dumped logits for a prefix - gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/kite-int6-logits
ops-bot: notice: runtime feature flag "opt-softmax-int6" rolled to staging on 2026-03-10 (deploy id: rel-2026-03-10-opt).
jorge: could be softmax numeric stability or a tokenizer fast-path used only by sampling. try forcing detok utf8-normalize and a runtime toggle (opt-softmax off)
claire: also suggests adding a small unit test during onboarding: measure parent_token_contiguity for CJK spans vs float baseline; block if delta > 0.04.
maya: quick mitigation: lowering temp to 0.6 reduces split_rate ~40% but doesn't close gap. forcing --detok=utf8-normalize helped a bit too.
jorge: i'll run a 3x2 matrix (detok: fast/utf/force; runtime opt on/off) with n=64 across locales zh,ja,en and collect KL + split_rate. ETA ~2h on staging.
eval-bot: CI run started: ci-7155 (kite-v2 int6 sampling matrix) link: https://ci.internal/runs/ci-7155 :spinner:
maya: filing ML-1501 with failing examples and assigning @jorge to bisect opt-softmax, @claire to add the unit test, @ops-bot to confirm rollout. will update in ~3h. :thumbsup:
